notes.title: Huge Playtest Update!!!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everybody! [/b]

We hope you guys are excited for our first big playtest update :3
A lot of the improvements and changes were suggestions that you (the community) gave us in our discord channel or in the youtube comments. 

If you also want to be a part of this journey, then please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/aRZpgPJE]official Garden Ink Discord channel[/url] !

Please let us know about your thoughts!

With much love,
Arne/Sven - Kranich Games
